verdict.description: Must agree with the findings array. PASS = zero findings (empty findings array). PASS_WITH_FIXES = at least one MEDIUM or LOW finding but no BLOCKER/HIGH. BLOCKS = at least one BLOCKER or HIGH.

verdict_reason.description: One-line rationale. Cite the single BLOCKER/HIGH driving BLOCKS, or 'no findings above LOW' for PASS_WITH_FIXES, or empty string for PASS.

severity.description: Intrinsic risk of the defect itself. Judge on blast radius (how much breaks), reversibility (can the damage be undone), silence (does it fail loudly or corrupt quietly), and recoverability (is data lost for good). BLOCKER = wide blast radius, irreversible or silent, data unrecoverable. HIGH = real failure in normal operation, recoverable but not silently. MEDIUM = latent trap or narrow-condition failure, loud when it fires. LOW = contained, obvious, trivially reversible.

autofix_class.description: Apply-authority — independent of severity. safe_auto = trivially reversible, no design call (e.g. rename an unused var). gated_auto = mechanically safe but wants human ack before applying (e.g. rename that ripples). manual = needs human implementation. advisory = surface only, no action expected.

line.description: 1-indexed line; use 0 for whole-file findings (module layout, missing header, wrong file entirely).

rationale.description: One paragraph: what breaks, why, what to verify. <=200 chars target; schema caps at 240 to allow a small overshoot without hard-reject.

unverifiable.description: true iff confirmation of this finding requires human judgment (taste, style, subjective preference) — no empirical check applies. Emit null when not applicable. Nullable-and-required rather than optional because OpenAI structured outputs (codex exec --output-schema) rejects any schema whose `required` array omits a declared property — Phase 2 hard-fails with invalid_json_schema otherwise.
